answers.goal: Becoming a creative/communications director, my goal is to break into the film industry.
answers.drew: Growing up as an only child, one can imagine the extent of time spent alone, only with your mind to keep you occupied. This made a deeply self-reflective and innovative young girl— creating ideas, images, and poetry to make sense of the world around her. The entertainment industry is a place where creatives like myself take a concept, an idea, and make reality out of it. Through my internships with Cambro, Bloom, and other start-ups, I’ve only grown more in my creativity, and want to apply it across more industries.
answers.seeking: Entrepreneurial archetypes, ambitious, fearless, passionate people. People who are willing and ready to put in their best work, as well as leaders who are ready to spearhead independent creative projects.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is Greta Gerwig. She is someone who took her time through higher education and schooling, cultivated lasting friendships, put herself out there; all to the avail of benefiting her long term in her career.
